thread:
Samir Das: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: eviction storm yesterday caused multiple model fallbacks and a couple customer-facing errors. Hotfix is in, but we need owners, runbook polish, and an automation to catch this earlier.
Zoe Li: I'll own the runbook rewrite. Plan: a one-page triage play + exact commands + escalation ladder. Aim to open PR by Fri.
Carlos Mendes: Add the diagnostic bundle script we used. Minimal commands to paste for oncall: 
```
P=$(kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl -n inference describe pod $P | egrep -i "evict|oom|pressure"
kubectl -n inference logs $P -c inference --tail=300
cat /var/log/kubelet.log | grep -i eviction | tail -n 200
curl -sS http://localhost:9090/metrics | grep kv_cache
```
Also include how to read eviction_score and node pressure signs.
Tanya Brooks: I'll lead remediation (spike + hardening). Proposal: 72h spike to try cache TTLs and batch caps, then a 2-week hardening epic for autoscaler and graceful degrade. Spike results due Tue EOD.
Samir Das: Escalation thresholds to add to the playbook:
- page @sre-oncall when >=3 pods evicted in 10m from same node-pool
- page @infra-lead if fallback route used >2x in 1h
- open INF ticket automatically if user error-rate >0.5% for 15m
Zoe Li: I'll add a canned Slack template for oncall to post in #incidents with the diagnostics bundle attached.
Carlos Mendes: I'll draft PromQL snippets for quick checks to paste in the runbook: 
```
sum by(node) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{reason="OOMKilled"}[5m]))
sum(rate(node_memory_pressure_seconds_total[5m]))
sum(kube_node_status_allocatable) - sum(kube_node_status_capacity)
```
And a small synthetic against the fallback model to monitor quality.
PagerDuty Bot: Created INF-5420 "Eviction hardening & triage playbook" and assigned Tanya, Zoe, Carlos.
Tanya Brooks: Spike plan posted in INF-5420: TTLs=[20s,40s,60s], batch_caps=[48,56]; run chaos load test Wed 09:00 PT. Will post results + recommended config.
Samir Das: Also add a "one-button rollback" recipe for autoscaler/batching config changes and a short validation checklist (p99 latency, kv hit ratio, no evictions for 30m).
Zoe Li: Runbook PR checklist: triage steps, pasteable commands, PromQL, escalation thresholds, canned messages, rollback recipe, and link to INF-5420. PR target Fri EOD.
Carlos Mendes: I'll build a tiny diag script that bundles logs and metrics into a gist to paste into the incident thread. Will attach to the PR.
Tanya Brooks: Action items for tracker (INF-5420): 1) Runbook PR (Zoe) by Fri EOD; 2) Spike + load tests (Tanya) by Wed 12:00 PT; 3) Alert rules + synthetic (Carlos) by next Wed; 4) Hardening epic kickoff after spike.
Samir Das: Thanks. Quick sync Fri 11:30 PT after load tests to decide sprint scope. Calendar invite incoming. :white_check_mark:
